_note: Affiliate providers. Only 'amazon-uk' is live at launch. Add other programmes here (e.g. Awin/Impact merchants) without touching templates: each product in products.json names a provider and the link builder in src/lib/links.mjs does the rest. Never put private keys or account credentials in this file.

amazon-uk.name: Amazon UK
policyNotes: Only use Special Links generated with the site's own tracking ID.
Do not display prices unless pulled live via the Product Advertising API; static prices go stale and breach the Operating Agreement.
Do not use Amazon product images unless obtained through approved means (PA-API/SiteStripe).
The Associates disclosure must be clearly visible on pages carrying Special Links (see /affiliate-disclosure/ and the per-page notice).
Do not use Special Links in emails, PDFs or offline documents.

awin-example.name: Awin network merchant (example, disabled)
awin-example.note: Template for a future network programme (mattress and bedding brands commonly use Awin). Set enabled:true and provide affiliateId in site.config.json when approved.
